commentary.text: 90+5' The match has just finished.
90+5' The resulting set piece from Ath Bilbao is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.
90+5' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) fails to send a pass into the box as his effort is cut out. Ath Bilbao have been awarded a corner kick.
90' 5 additional min. will be played.
90' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) takes a shot from the edge of the box, but it's not a big threat for the goalkeeper as his effort is blocked by a defender.
90' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
89' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Ath Bilbao will take a corner kick.
89' The manager has been forced to make a substitution and the injured Marc Bartra (Betis) limps off the pitch to be replaced by Natan.
88' Youssouf Sabaly (Betis) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
87' Romain Perraud (Betis) whips the ball into the penalty area, but one of the defenders is alert and spanks it away.
87' The Betis players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
85' Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Rui Silva, who smothers the ball.
83' Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) picks up a precise pass deep inside the box, but his strike is saved by the keeper.
82' The attendance for today's match is 46898.
81' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) attempts to find the head of one of his teammates with a promising cross into the box, but a defender outjumps the attackers and averts the threat.
79' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Andoni Gorosabel (Ath Bilbao) replaces Oscar de Marcos.
79' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor prepares a substitution. Benat Prados Diaz is replaced by Unai Gomez (Ath Bilbao).
78' The corner is swung in but Ath Bilbao can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

76' Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) is first to latch onto the rebound inside the penalty area. He sends a promising shot towards the middle of the goal, but it is denied by the goalkeeper who pulls off a superb save.

76' Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao) receives a precise pass and is given time inside the box to send a promising strike towards the middle of the goal. Rui Silva guesses his intention and denies him with a fine save.
74' Benat Prados Diaz (Ath Bilbao) was too fierce in his attempt to get the ball from his opponent and Javier Alberola Rojas blows for a foul.
72' We are about to witness a subsitution. Cedric Bakambu (Betis) for Vitor Roque.
71' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) strikes the ball towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes an easy save. He should have scored that.
69' Ernesto Valverde Tejedor has decided to make a change. Javier Marton (Ath Bilbao) replaces Oihan Sancet.
69' That's the end of the game for Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta, who is replaced by Ander Herrera (Ath Bilbao).
68' 1 - 1 Oscar de Marcos crosses the ball into the box. Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) gets onto the scoresheet by sweetly powering a header into the top right corner – 1:1.

67' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) is obviously not following the Golden Rule: "Treat others as you want to be treated.“ He makes a bad challenge and leaves Javier Alberola Rojas with no other option than to blow for a foul.
66' Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) sends a cross into the box, but Rui Silva comes off his line to gather the ball.
65' Substitution. Alex Berenguer (Ath Bilbao) in, Alvaro Djalo out.
65' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Betis comes to nothing.

64' Superb touch by Iker Losada (Betis) as he receives a precise pass inside the box. He finds the keeper prepared as he unleashes his shot to the left side of the goal. Wonderful save! The ball is out of play. Betis win a corner kick.
63' Ath Bilbao can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
63' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge. Now Ath Bilbao have a corner.
62' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) connects with a pass inside the box, but his effort goes well wide of the left post.
58' Javier Alberola Rojas blows for a foul after Assane Diao (Betis) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
56' Pablo Fornals (Betis) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
55' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) breaks into the box and goes over after a challenge from an opposition player, but the ref signals NO penalty!
55' Abde Ezzalzouli (Betis) stands over the free kick and opts to take it himself, but it is straight at Julen Agirrezabala.
52' 0 - 1 Assane Diao feeds the ball through to Pablo Fornals (Betis), who picks up the pass inside the box and quickly sends it into the bottom left corner! The goalkeeper was helpless. 0:1!
50' Alvaro Djalo (Ath Bilbao) finds himself behind the opposition's defence, but the game is stopped for offside.
48' Rough tackle by Vitor Roque (Betis). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
46' Half-time substitution. Manuel Pellegrini decided to make a change. Sergi Altimira (Betis) is replaced by Iker Losada.
46' Half-time substitution. Hector Bellerin is replaced by Youssouf Sabaly (Betis).
46' There will be a change on the pitch for the second half. Manuel Pellegrini probably wasn't satisfied with the performance of Chimy Avila. He is replaced by Assane Diao (Betis).
46' The referee blows his whistle to signal the start of the second half.
45' The match has reached half-time.
44' Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) escapes without any punishment from the referee after using excessive force to foul his opponent.
41' It looks like Johnny Cardoso (Betis) saw red with that tackle. Javier Alberola Rojas won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
40' Aitor Paredes (Ath Bilbao) rises high to connect with a cross from the corner kick, but his decent header crashes against the right post and ricochets away!
40' Corner kick. Ath Bilbao will have an opportunity.
39' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Ath Bilbao force their opponents to concede a corner.
38' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
37' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) gets on the end of a pass on the edge of the box but his shot is blocked.
36' Betis hold the ball and are exchanging some long passes.
33' A dangerous looking corner kick from Inigo Ruiz de Galarreta (Ath Bilbao) is cleared to safety by the defence.
33' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) produces a dangerous low pass into the penalty area, but the defence manage to cut it out. The referee blows his whistle, Ath Bilbao are awarded a corner kick.
31' The Betis players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
28' Javier Alberola Rojas couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Sergi Altimira (Betis) and blew his whistle.
27' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Yuri Berchiche (Ath Bilbao) offside.
26' The possession of the ball – 47:53.
24' Another attempt to send the ball beyond the defence by Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is thwarted and cleared to safety.
22' The Betis players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.

20' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) was presented with a great chance after a cross found him all alone in the box, but his effort towards the middle of the goal lacked pace and was comfortably saved by Rui Silva.
18' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
17' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) gets a shot from the edge of the box, but it crashes against the crossbar!
14' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) controls a cross inside the six-yard box, but sends his shot slightly wide of the right post.
12' Romain Perraud (Betis) crosses the ball into the box, but one of the defending players averts the threat.
11' Oihan Sancet (Ath Bilbao) attempts to test the goalkeeper after collecting a cross inside the penalty area. Luck doesn't appear to be on his side today as his attempt rattles the left post.
9' Some patient build-up play from Ath Bilbao as they look to unlock the defence.
6' Nico Williams (Ath Bilbao) is afforded space inside the box after collecting a pass, but the chance is wasted as his shot goes harmlessly over the crossbar.
5' Inaki Williams (Ath Bilbao) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
3' Hector Bellerin (Betis) gives away a foul for a fierce tackle on an opponent.
1' Johnny Cardoso (Betis) commits a rough foul. Javier Alberola Rojas stops the game and makes a call.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
The players are on the pitch and Betis will have the kick-off.
Javier Alberola Rojas got the nomination for today's game and will try his best to be a fair judge and not make any mistakes.
